biotools.summary: pyXLMS is a python package and web application with graphical user interface that aims to simplify and streamline the intermediate step of connecting crosslink search engine results with down-stream analysis tools, enabling researchers even without bioinformatics knowledge to conduct in-depth crosslink analyses and shifting the focus from data transformation to data interpretation and therefore gaining biological insight.
